summary.en: Opus for deep architecture and Sonnet for high-performance everyday agent work.
summary.zh: Opus 面向深度架构，Sonnet 面向高性能日常 Agent 工作。

title.en: Choose Claude when the work must hold together over many steps.
title.zh: 当工作需要跨越多步仍保持一致时，选择 Claude。

description.en: Use Claude Opus 4.6 for demanding reasoning and architecture; use Claude Sonnet 4.6 for coding and broad day-to-day agent tasks.
description.zh: Claude Opus 4.6 适合高难度推理与架构设计；Claude Sonnet 4.6 适合编程和广泛的日常 Agent 任务。

title.en: Pick depth or throughput without leaving the project.
title.zh: 在同一项目中选择推理深度或执行效率。

description.en: The client exposes the 4.6 generation directly; newer families also appear in the broader Floatboat support matrix.
description.zh: 客户端可直接选择 4.6 代模型；更新系列也进入了 Floatboat 的更广泛支持矩阵。

description.en: Complex architecture, long-horizon planning, and difficult reasoning.
description.zh: 复杂架构、长程规划与高难度推理。

description.en: High-performance coding and general agent execution.
description.zh: 高性能编程与通用 Agent 执行。

description.en: Evaluation profiles with 1M context and 128k output budgets.
description.zh: 已配置 1M 上下文与 128k 输出预算的评测画像。

title.en: Work that rewards coherence, not just a quick answer.
title.zh: 适合重视长程一致性，而不只是快速回答的任务。

description.en: Hold constraints, tradeoffs, and dependencies together before proposing a design.
description.zh: 在提出设计前，同时把握约束、取舍与依赖关系。

description.en: Plan and inspect changes that cross modules instead of treating each file in isolation.
description.zh: 规划并检查跨模块修改，而不是孤立处理每个文件。

description.en: Maintain intent across research, implementation, verification, and revision.
description.zh: 在调研、实现、验证和修订之间保持任务意图。

question.en: When should I choose Opus instead of Sonnet?
question.zh: 什么时候应选 Opus 而不是 Sonnet？

answer.en: Choose Opus when reasoning depth and architectural consistency outweigh latency. Sonnet is the stronger default for everyday coding and agent work.
answer.zh: 当推理深度和架构一致性比延迟更重要时选择 Opus；日常编程和 Agent 工作优先考虑 Sonnet。

question.en: Are Claude 5 models in the client picker?
question.zh: Claude 5 系列在客户端选择器中吗？

answer.en: No. `claude-opus-5`, `claude-sonnet-5`, and `claude-fable-5` have evaluation and capacity budgets, but are not exposed in the picker.
answer.zh: 不在。`claude-opus-5`、`claude-sonnet-5` 与 `claude-fable-5` 已配置评测与容量预算，但未在选择器露出。

title.en: Give complex work enough room to stay coherent.
title.zh: 给复杂工作足够空间，保持前后一致。

description.en: Select Claude when architecture, code, and long-running decisions need to remain aligned.
description.zh: 当架构、代码和长程决策需要持续对齐时，选择 Claude。
